operation.description:
Merges a pull request into the base branch.
This endpoint triggers [notifications](https://docs.github.com/github/managing-subscriptions-and-notifications-on-github/about-notifications). Creating content too quickly using this endpoint may result in secondary rate limiting. For more information, see "[Rate limits for the API](https://docs.github.com/rest/using-the-rest-api/rate-limits-for-the-rest-api#about-secondary-rate-limits)" and "[Best practices for using the REST API](https://docs.github.com/rest/guides/best-practices-for-using-the-rest-api)."

value.commit_message: Add a new value to the merge_method enum

commit_message.description: Extra detail to append to automatic commit message.

commit_title.description: Title for the automatic commit message.

sha.description: SHA that pull request head must match to allow merge.

405.description: Method Not Allowed if merge cannot be performed

value.message: Head branch was modified. Review and try the merge again.

409.description: Conflict if sha was provided and pull request head did not match

#/components/parameters/owner.description: The account owner of the repository. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/owner.name: owner

#/components/parameters/pull-number.description: The number that identifies the pull request.
#/components/parameters/pull-number.name: pull_number

#/components/parameters/repo.description: The name of the repository without the `.git` extension. The name is not case sensitive.
#/components/parameters/repo.name: repo

#/components/responses/validation_failed.description: Validation failed, or the endpoint has been spammed.
